items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Leon Rene happened to go in there one night, and he was listening... Rene had a recording company. And he said...this is a hunch: 'I'm going to record these guys.'

ctx.x: Well, was there a market for that kind of stuff around that time?

Well, what happened was, Joe Liggins was playing around here in a small after-hours joint called Jack's Basket, and Joe Liggins wrote that tune called "The Honeydripper." Every time he played it in this little club, people would give him a terrific hand or response for it. And Leon Rene happened to go in there one night, and he was listening...
